\paragraph{ReasonIF.} On ReasonIF the Qwen3-14B teacher difference is larger than on CoT-Control (Table~\ref{tab:teacher}, last column). The Claude 3.7 student's instruction-following success rises from 14.0\% to 29.3\% ($+15.3$, $[10.0, 20.7]$), the R1 student's does not (13.0\%), and the paired difference between them is $+16.3$, $[11.0, 21.7]$ ($+17.0$ without the 24 overlapping questions; $+13.8$ without the word-limit constraint, which shorter reasoning passes more easily). Its accuracy falls further (80.3\% to 57.3\%, against 70.7\% for the R1 student), mostly because 73 of its 300 responses reach the 16,384-token limit without an answer (18 for the R1 student, 19 for Base), mainly on harder questions (Base accuracy 64.4\% on them). On the 274 questions on which Base and the R1 student both finish, a selection that does not depend on the Claude 3.7 student's outputs, the IFS difference is $+18.6$, $[13.1, 24.1]$.
